The newer Tesla Model Y offers an 8-inch rear touchscreen, mounted behind the center console between the front seats.

What can the rear screen do?

Climate control: Adjust rear air conditioning and airflow.

Entertainment: Watch videos, stream content, and play games.

Bluetooth headphones: Connect up to two pairs.

Seat controls: Adjust rear seat heating and supported seat positions.

Music: Control playback and volume.

Tesla confirms these capabilities in its Model Y owner's manual.

Important: Not every Model Y includes the rear screen. The 2026 Premium and Performance trims have it, while the current base Standard trims do not.
